title: Integration on a compact space
statement: Let $X$ be a compact topological space equipped with a measurable structure whose measurable sets include the Borel sets, and let $\mu$ be a finite measure on $X$. Integration against $\mu$ defines a continuous complex-linear functional on the continuous complex-valued functions on $X$, sending $F$ to $\int_X F\,d\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: the measurable structure contains the Borel sets
